doc: What a press does while a hunter rises up a ledge (Hunter._ledge_rise, MantleCarry), the same for every hero. Read by DashFlow (scripts/arch/dash_flow.gd). mode: fire (goes mid-climb, the rise goes on) or buffer (waits for the top). seen: false marks a row the source doesn't show ([?] in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md): those buffer, never cancel. Asserted by --mantle-press-check.

lmb.source: Not shown inside a rise. Closest: sv_joule_1v4.mp4 9.20-9.27 s (briefs/supervive-data/MANTLE_185b.md): a hunter tops a low rim and stands firing ~0.07 s later, a shot at the top, not one in the rise.

rmb.source: Not shown: no RMB inside a mantle in the data (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_physics.md, Mantle) or the hero footage (briefs/hero-ref).

e.source: Not shown: no E inside a mantle in the data (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_physics.md, Mantle) or the hero footage (briefs/hero-ref).

x.source: Not shown: no ultimate inside a mantle in the data (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_physics.md, Mantle) or the hero footage (briefs/hero-ref).

dash.source: Footage owner_mantle_clip.mp4 17.9-18.6 s (briefs/supervive-data/MANTLE_185b.md): a dash at an abyss rim goes over it and onto the grass at dash-trail speed, no stop. Data: the mantle is a suction force and a Z impulse during the fall (supervive_physics.md, Mantle), with no state that ends a dash.

jump.source: Owner's account of the source (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md, Ledges): 'a well-timed input or jump gives a better fling. The game never takes control.' Ours: the fling (Hunter._ledge_fling).
